**Who to reach:** operations managers and operations directors at mid-size logistics firms in the UK. Skip recruiters, staffing agencies and sole traders.

**How to write:** plain, human, one clear ask per email, no pressure, no jargon. Keep every email short. One polite follow-up if there is no reply, then stop. Stop all emails as soon as the person replies.

For context on timing, replies to a first email land around six days in on similar campaigns (median across 41).

Shall I put these directions on the campaign and let those 123 emails go out?

>

>
> **Replies:** anyone who shows interest is handed straight to you, with a time offered for a call.
